question: 122B hybrid prefill: pin what fits in 63 GB RAM, stream the rest from NVMe

live_ram.note: 29.4 GB of RSS is today's pinned bank

notes: prefill reads the WHOLE remote bank every pass; the cold fraction pays NVMe every pass (hotness ordering does not cut prefill bytes, only decode placement)
pass floor = max(bank/DMA, cold/NVMe); transfer floor only, compute additive
pinnable hot ceiling ~35-40 GB realistic (server 3.5 + system ~9 in 63 GB, swap already full); 44 GB is OOM territory
single drive; disk 94% full; GPTQ download was writing concurrently during measurement (negligible vs 6 GB/s)
verdict: hybrid is VIABLE but 3-4x slower per pass than upgraded RAM: ~3.2-4.0 s/pass (hot 35-40 GB) vs 1.03 s/pass all-hot. 128K transfer floor ~50-63 s hybrid vs ~17 s upgraded. Decode/capacity/MTP unaffected either way.
